title: Tristan Wirfs can't blame Bucs fans for not showing up vs. Steelers

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tristan Wirfs can't blame Bucs fans for not showing up vs. Steelers
sources.description: Steelers fans overwhelmed Raymond James Stadium on Sunday, boosting the road team's effort to overcome a 13-0 halftime deficit and a 16-3 fourth-quarter deficit.
